title: 55th Festival of Popular Arts Opens in Marrakech July 2-6 — Full Programme Revealed
body:
The 55th Festival National des Arts Populaires (FNAP) runs July 2-6 at Bab Jdid and El Badi Palace. Over 60 troupes from all Moroccan regions perform Ahidous, Gnawa, Guedra, Aita and more. International guests include troupes from Senegal and Spain.

Access

Bab Jdid performances are FREE. El Badi Palace: 30 MAD (20 MAD Moroccan nationals). Evening shows begin at 8:30 PM. No advance booking — arrive early. Grand finale July 6 at El Badi Palace.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech and Ministry of Culture.
